summary: Iteration 20 (Newsletter HTML templates + Bounces page). Backend: 9/9 pytest passed. Frontend: preview HTML exact, test-send button conditional, badge, campaign type filter and Bounces page all work. Found 1 real UX bug: opening Preview from the Template editor and then closing it (via Escape or outside click) also closes the underlying Template edit dialog, losing all user input — user cannot preview then save.

ui_bugs.issue: Preview and Template editor are sibling Radix <Dialog> components. When both are open and the Preview is dismissed (Escape or outside-click), the underlying Template edit dialog also closes, discarding all form data. Users must re-enter name/subject/HTML/text after previewing to be able to Save.

action_items: Fix the nested-dialog UX in Templates.jsx: either render Preview as a controlled sub-panel INSIDE the same DialogContent (toggle in place), or use modal={false} on the outer Dialog / manage z-index so closing Preview does not close the editor. Recommended: keep the Preview inline (an expandable panel) or open Preview with the editor Dialog closed but state preserved.
critical_code_review_comments: Templates.jsx: two top-level Dialogs (`open` and `preview`) leads to Radix closing both on Escape/outside click — nested modal anti-pattern. Prefer a single dialog with a preview toggle.
api.py preview_template accepts a raw `dict` body — no Pydantic validation; consider a TemplatePreview model for type-safety.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend for newsletter templates and bounces endpoint is fully verified. Remaining issue is a frontend UX bug in /app/frontend/src/pages/Templates.jsx where the Preview Dialog closes the parent template editor Dialog on dismiss. After fix, re-test: open Templates -> Novo template -> template-type-html -> fill fields -> Preview (verify iframe still shows exact HTML) -> close Preview (Escape/outside click) -> verify Template edit dialog stays open with data intact -> Save. Also validate the same flow works for plain templates (which historically may have same issue).
rca of the issue: Templates.jsx renders `<Dialog open={open}>` (template editor) and `<Dialog open={!!preview}>` (preview) as siblings. Radix @radix-ui/react-dialog renders a DialogOverlay per open dialog. When the topmost preview is dismissed by outside-click, the mousedown event that closes it also hits the underlying editor's overlay pointer target — causing both to unmount together and losing all component state (form). Reproduction: /templates -> Novo template -> template-type-html -> fill fields -> Preview -> click outside preview or press Escape twice -> observe editor dialog is gone, form data lost. Mitigation: put preview inline as a collapsible section within the same DialogContent, or gate the outer dialog with modal={false}, or open Preview via a portal that stops event propagation.
